summary: Roomy mid-size electric SUV with a huge boot and Kia's class-leading 7-year warranty, priced to undercut most mid-size EV rivals.
pros: Largest boot in this comparison at 513L (1714L seats down)
Comfortable, family-friendly interior with strong rear-seat space
cons: Entry Air Standard Range is front-wheel drive only and rated to tow just 300kg braked
DC charging tops out lower than rivals, so road-trip top-ups take longer
Firmer low-speed ride than some competitors on Melbourne's rougher back streets
